heard: Tamar, Bor, Perez and Zerah, Judah had five sons in all Hezron and Hamon were his sons, the line begins to stand Pettis, father of Hezron, Hezron, father of Ram Grandfather of Amenadiel Amenadiel, father of Nashon Nashon, father of Salmon Salmon, link in the chain Boaz, Obed, Jesse Jesse, son of David The name Shemuth is hidden in the scroll of Ruth From Perez to the king
